metricText: Number of certificates issued by Ghana's Value for Money Office during a fixed reporting year, once the Office publishes its own official reporting.
note: PROPOSED FUTURE VENUE: No certificate count or recurring VfM Office reporting product is captured yet. Ghana News Agency reports that Parliament passed the Bill on 2026-03-25 and that the President assented to it on 2026-05-11; the official 2026 Mid-Year Fiscal Policy Review commits MoF to fully operationalise the Office by end-June 2027. The related implementation-milestone question is only a candidate until registration defines an exact official resolution signal. gh-vfm-office-act-2026 is a reserved future bills/ slug; no such entry exists yet.
